text: {"summary": "The prod cluster scored NSA 55.0 and MITRE 58.0 in kubescape, with 13 and 11 failed controls. The one application workload with host access is shop/Deployment/checkout, which uses hostNetwork. The other hostNetwork, host PID/IPC and capability findings are on node-exporter and the k3s svclb-traefik add-on, where this access is expected. The only admin binding is cluster-admin for Group system:masters, which looks like a platform default. Trivy found no critical or high vulnerabilities and no secrets.", "targets": ["prod"], "frameworks": [{"name": "NSA", "passed": 8, "failed": 13, "skipped": 5, "score": 55}, {"name": "MITRE", "passed": 9, "failed": 11, "skipped": 5, "score": 58}], "findings": [{"severity": "HIGH", "title": "Application workload uses host network", "resource": "shop/Deployment/checkout", "controls": ["C-0041", "KSV-0009", "Trivy PSS 2 Host Namespaces"], "evidence": "Kubescape C-0041 and Trivy KSV-0009 both list shop/Deployment/checkout among 3 resources with host network access, and Trivy PSS control 2 reports 3 fails.", "fix": "kubectl -n shop patch deploy checkout --type=json -p='[{\"op\":\"remove\",\"path\":\"/spec/template/spec/hostNetwork\"}]'"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "svclb-traefik uses host network and insecure capabilities (k3s add-on, expected)", "resource": "kube-system/DaemonSet/svclb-traefik", "controls": ["C-0041", "C-0046", "KSV-0009"], "evidence": "Kubescape flags C-0041 (host network) and C-0046 (insecure capabilities) on this k3s-managed kube-system DaemonSet, which is expected for the k3s service load balancer.", "fix": "No change normally needed. To remove it, start k3s with --disable servicelb, or accept the risk and document it."}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "node-exporter host network and host PID/IPC (expected)", "resource": "monitoring/DaemonSet/kps-prometheus-node-exporter", "controls": ["C-0041", "C-0038", "KSV-0009"], "evidence": "Kubescape flags C-0041 and C-0038 on node-exporter, which needs host access to collect node metrics.", "fix": "Accept and document the exception. Limit the exposed port with a NetworkPolicy to the Prometheus pods."}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "cluster-admin bound to system:masters (likely platform default)", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/cluster-admin", "controls": [], "evidence": "The rbac_and_argo data shows one admin binding, cluster-admin, with the single subject Group system:masters, and no wildcard roles or other subjects are listed.", "fix": "kubectl get clusterrolebinding cluster-admin -o yaml  # confirm it is the default.
